title: Retrieval serves at most 3 records per moment behind a precision gate
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/night/proof-path.md; grant memory proof-redesign-grant (2026-11-18).
Outcome: the standards packet at task start, before edit and before Stop serves at most 3 records and none below a retrieval-confidence threshold; the threshold and cap are recorded in the packet output.
Files: src/brain/packet.ts, src/brain/standards-cli.ts
Proof: a packet test with 10 matching records serves 3, and a query with only low-confidence matches serves none.
